says: Almost nothing is recorded for this theme: only one video has comment data, and none of the 47 viewer questions from run 1 is about hair. Under a Tagalog hair-botox plug, viewers said their hair felt sticky the next day and asked whether it works on coloured or rebonded hair, where to buy it and how much it costs. The medical claims point to what people are worried about without saying it: that early shedding means the treatment is failing, that the loss will be permanent, and that nothing without minoxidil in it really works.
